result.brief: 提出 Disen-Forcing：通过解耦上下文路由与运动解耦正则，区分语义锚定头与局部时序头，缓解自回归视频扩散长时rollout的过条件化与运动坍缩。
result.reason: Analyzes attention-head specialization in autoregressive video diffusion and proposes distillation-time context routing to stabilize long-horizon generation, directly serving video generation.
